chunks: And by this chain, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ʿAmmār ibn Marwān, from Munakhkhal, from Jābir, who said:
Jibraʾīl عليه السلام descended with this verse upon Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم like this:
And if you are in doubt concerning what We have sent down upon Our servant regarding ʿAlī, then bring a surah like it.

key_terms.الْآيَةِ: the verse being cited in the narration
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibraʾīl عليه السلام, the angel of revelation
key_terms.سُورَةٍ: a chapter of revelation brought as a challenge
key_terms.عَبْدِنَا: Our servant, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فِي عَلِيٍّ: regarding ʿAlī عليه السلام, as stated in this reported wording

ai.seo_question: How does this narration interpret the verse about doubting what was revealed to Allah’s servant in relation to ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration presents a cited revelatory wording connected to the verse, specifying the phrase "regarding ʿAlī" in relation to what was sent down to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. Its significance in the chapter context is its use as a proof-text concerning the wilayah and rank of Imām ʿAlī عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: And by this chain, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ammar Bin Marwan, from Munakhhal, from Jabir,
‘Heasws said: ‘Jibraeelas descended with this Verse upon Muhammadsaww like this
[2:23] And if you are in doubt as to that which We have Revealed to Our servant regarding Aliasws then bring a Chapter like it’.
en.sarwar: 26. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from Munakhkhal from Jabir who has said the following.
“Jibril this verse of the Holy Quran to Prophet Muhammad (s.a) as herein below.
“Should you have any doubt about what We have revealed to Our servant, (about Leadership Ali (a.s). with Divine Authority) present one chapter comparable to it . .” [2:23]
